scenes.section: What a LOINC code looks like

lines.raw: A LOINC code is a **number, a dash, and one check digit**.
lines.say: A L O I N C code is a number, a dash, and one check digit.

lines.raw: The number has no hidden meaning: codes are simply handed out in order.
lines.say: The number has no hidden meaning: codes are simply handed out in order.

lines.raw: The last digit is calculated from the others, so a typing mistake can be caught.
lines.say: The last digit is calculated from the others, so a typing mistake can be caught.

scenes.section: What a LOINC code looks like

lines.raw: LOINC 4548-4 (HbA1c).
lines.say: L O I N C 4 5 4 8 dash 4 (H b A 1 c).

lines.raw: 4548: **Item number**: just a serial number.
lines.say: 4548: Item number: just a serial number.

lines.raw: It does not mean "blood" or "sugar" by itself.
lines.say: It does not mean "blood" or "sugar" by itself.

lines.raw: -: A dash, always before the last digit.
lines.say: -: A dash, always before the last digit.

lines.raw: 4: **Check digit**: worked out from 4548 by a formula.
lines.say: 4: Check digit: worked out from 4548 by a formula.

lines.raw: If someone types `4548-5`, a system can tell it is wrong.
lines.say: If someone types 4 5 4 8 dash 5, a system can tell it is wrong.

scenes.section: What a LOINC code looks like

lines.raw: Store LOINC codes as text.
lines.say: Store L O I N C codes as text.

lines.raw: Keep the dash and store the code as **text**, not a number.
lines.say: Keep the dash and store the code as text, not a number.

lines.raw: `4548-4` stored as a number becomes `4544` (4548 minus 4), which is nonsense.
lines.say: 4 5 4 8 dash 4 stored as a number becomes 4 5 4 4 (4548 minus 4), which is nonsense.

lines.raw: Lengths also vary: `718-7` and `13457-7` are both valid LOINC codes.
lines.say: Lengths also vary: 7 1 8 dash 7 and 1 3 4 5 7 dash 7 are both valid L O I N C codes.

lines.say: The six parts of a L O I N C name.

scenes.section: The six parts of a LOINC name

lines.raw: Behind every code is a **fully specified name** with six parts.
lines.say: Behind every code is a fully specified name with six parts.

lines.raw: Together they describe a test so exactly that two different tests can never share a code.
lines.say: Together they describe a test so exactly that two different tests can never share a code.

scenes.section: The six parts of a LOINC name

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.
lines.say: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: **1. Component**. Question it answers: What is measured? HbA1c (4548-4): Hemoglobin A1c / Hemoglobin.total. Glucose (2345-7): Glucose.
lines.say: 1. Component. Question it answers: What is measured? H b A 1 c (4 5 4 8 dash 4): Hemoglobin A1c or Hemoglobin.total. Glucose (2 3 4 5 dash 7): Glucose.

lines.raw: **2. Property**. Question it answers: What kind of amount? HbA1c (4548-4): `MFr`: mass fraction (a percentage). Glucose (2345-7): `MCnc`: mass concentration (mg per dL).
lines.say: 2. Property. Question it answers: What kind of amount? H b A 1 c (4 5 4 8 dash 4): MFr: mass fraction (a percentage). Glucose (2 3 4 5 dash 7): MCnc: mass concentration (mg per dL).

lines.raw: **3. Time**. Question it answers: At one moment, or over a period? HbA1c (4548-4): `Pt`: a single point in time. Glucose (2345-7): `Pt`: a single point in time.
lines.say: 3. Time. Question it answers: At one moment, or over a period? H b A 1 c (4 5 4 8 dash 4): Pt: a single point in time. Glucose (2 3 4 5 dash 7): Pt: a single point in time.

lines.raw: **4. System**. Question it answers: Which specimen? HbA1c (4548-4): `Bld`: whole blood. Glucose (2345-7): `Ser/Plas`: serum or plasma (the liquid part of blood).
lines.say: 4. System. Question it answers: Which specimen? H b A 1 c (4 5 4 8 dash 4): Bld: whole blood. Glucose (2 3 4 5 dash 7): Ser/Plas: serum or plasma (the liquid part of blood).

lines.raw: **5. Scale**. Question it answers: Number, category or text? HbA1c (4548-4): `Qn`: quantitative (a number). Glucose (2345-7): `Qn`: quantitative (a number).
lines.say: 5. Scale. Question it answers: Number, category or text? H b A 1 c (4 5 4 8 dash 4): Qn: quantitative (a number). Glucose (2 3 4 5 dash 7): Qn: quantitative (a number).

lines.raw: **6. Method**. Question it answers: How was it measured? (often left blank). HbA1c (4548-4): Blank: any method. Glucose (2345-7): Blank: any method.
lines.say: 6. Method. Question it answers: How was it measured? (often left blank). H b A 1 c (4 5 4 8 dash 4): Blank: any method. Glucose (2 3 4 5 dash 7): Blank: any method.

scenes.section: Key takeaways

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: LOINC gives each kind of test one universal code, so results from any lab can be combined.
lines.say: L O I N C gives each kind of test one universal code, so results from any lab can be combined.

lines.raw: A LOINC code is a serial number + dash + check digit, e.g. `4548-4`.
lines.say: A L O I N C code is a serial number and dash and check digit, for example 4 5 4 8 dash 4.

lines.raw: Store it as text.
lines.say: Store it as text.

lines.raw: Six parts define a test: component, property, time, system, scale, method.
lines.say: Six parts define a test: component, property, time, system, scale, method.

lines.raw: Change any part (specimen, units type, method) and you get a different code.
lines.say: Change any part (specimen, units type, method) and you get a different code.

lines.raw: CPT names the billed service on the claim; LOINC names the measured result.
lines.say: C P T names the billed service on the claim; L O I N C names the measured result.
